panels.title: 일별 DAU (최근 30일)
panels.description: 일별 활성 유저 수. 당일은 집계 중.

targets.expr: count by (d, day) (sum by (d, day, user) (count_over_time({job="renzzle-backend"} |= "RequestLoggingFilter - " != "[user=]" | pattern `<_> [user=<user>] <_>` | label_format d=`{{ date "2006-01-02" (add (unixEpoch __timestamp__) 32400) }}`, day=`{{ date "01/02 Mon" (add (unixEpoch __timestamp__) 32400) }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: 주별 WAU (최근 12주)
panels.description: 주별(월요일 시작) 활성 유저 수. 이번 주는 집계 중.

targets.expr: count by (w, wk) (sum by (w, wk, user) (count_over_time({job="renzzle-backend"} |= "RequestLoggingFilter - " != "[user=]" | pattern `<_> [user=<user>] <_>` | label_format w=`{{ date "2006-01-02" (mul (sub (mul (div (add (div (add (unixEpoch __timestamp__) 32400) 86400) 3) 7) 7) 3) 86400) }}`, wk=`{{ date "01/02~" (mul (sub (mul (div (add (div (add (unixEpoch __timestamp__) 32400) 86400) 3) 7) 7) 3) 86400) }}` [$__range])))

targets.expr: count by (m) (sum by (m, user) (count_over_time({job="renzzle-backend"} |= "RequestLoggingFilter - " != "[user=]" | pattern `<_> [user=<user>] <_>` | label_format m=`{{ date "2006-01" (add (unixEpoch __timestamp__) 32400) }}` [$__range])))
